newsitem.title: UK: Train problems derail Stagecoach shares.
newsitem.headline: Train problems derail Stagecoach shares.

text.p: Shares in transport group Stagecoach Holdings Plc fell 16-1/2 pence to 740 after its South West Trains franchise said the total bill for compensating passengers for cancellations could total 1.75 million stg.
The SW Trains comments come after train regulator OPRAF warned it might might impose a one million stg fine against Stagecoach if SW Trains continued to perform poorly.
The watchdog wants SW Trains to run at least 98.5 percent of services scheduled for April and May.
Stagecoach said it was confident it could meet the OPRAF's requirements.
The problems with SW Trains began when the franchise cut staff and then found it had too few drivers to operate schedules.
